frozen_defects.name: FOCUS_FALLS_TO_BODY_ON_WORKS_ROW_VIEWER_CLOSE
frozen_defects.detail: openTemplate() sets worksOverlay.hidden = true before returning control; the later lastFocus?.focus in closeViewer() targets the WORKS row, which is now inside a [hidden] container and therefore cannot receive focus, so focus falls through to BODY. Reproduced identically at 1440x900, 430x932, and 390x844. Contrast: ESC from a viewer opened on the visible .showreel button correctly restores focus to that button.

frozen_defects.name: MOBILE_MENU_FOCUS_TRAPPED_ON_HIDDEN_MENU_CLOSE
frozen_defects.detail: setMenu(false) toggles the open class, sets aria-hidden, and zeroes transition delays but implements no focus restoration, leaving focus on #menuClose inside #menuOverlay[aria-hidden=true]. Chromium confirms: 'Blocked aria-hidden on an element because its descendant retained focus... Element with focus: <button.icon-btn#menuClose>, Ancestor with aria-hidden: <div.menu-overlay#menuOverlay>'.
